name: Ume wa Saita ka
source:
This is the volume 1 of the 100 yen series.

The main character is busy with the study and part-time jobs.
He is frustrated for not being able to see Koume, his girlfriend often.
One day, he finds her in his bed, who sleeps on his bed after cleaning up his room. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE056485.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
本作是100日元系列的第1弹。

主人公忙于学习和打工，因此很少能见到女友小梅，心中也一直郁郁不快。
某天，他回到房间，发现小梅在帮他打扫完房间后，竟躺在他的床上睡着了。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE056485.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
